name: datareceipt
description: See what trackers earn from your browsing: detects third-party trackers live and estimates the revenue tied to tracking you.

scripts.package:chrome: yarn build:prod && mkdir -p dist/chrome && cd build && zip -qr ../dist/chrome/datareceipt-$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: yarn build:firefox:prod && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir build-firefox --artifacts-dir dist/firefox
